instruction.text: What material is this dragon made of?

atoms.b: Paper is a thin, lightweight, ((flammable --magnetic)) material. It is made from ((plant_fibers --metal_cuttings)). The fibers are mixed into a wet ((pulp --broth)). The pulp is dried out and ((pressed --stretched)) into sheets with great force.

An early version of paper was already being used in Egypt ((++5,000 20)) years ago. This material was called ((papyrus --cardboard)), and it was made from the fibrous stems of the papyrus plant. The first paper made from ((wood --glass)), like we use today, was invented ((in_China --at_the_North_Pole)) 2,000 years ago.

We use paper for all sorts of things every day, including ((writing --sleeping)), drawing and printing. The ((notes --coins)) we buy things with are made from paper. We also use particularly thick, sturdy varieties of paper such as card and ((cardboard --plastic)) to make things like packaging.
